Name: Living Fields
Author: seifkingSK
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/Q8SPWdL.png[/img]
[url=https://www.stardewvalley.net/][img]https://i.imgur.com/2mqL6Uu.png[/img][/url] [url=https://smapi.io/][img]https://i.imgur.com/z1YXh1a.png[/img][/url] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/54492][img]https://i.imgur.com/pu4KdGu.png[/img][/url] [img]https://i.imgur.com/KqHkrSg.png[/img] [img]https://i.imgur.com/dLkzl2p.png[/img] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][img]https://i.imgur.com/cNhm40R.png[/img][/url] [/center]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/UINQfef.png[/img]
[left][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753][color=#e69138]Stardew Valley Expanded[/color][/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286][color=#e69138]Ridgeside Village[/color][/url] (and a few other expansions) paint crop fields for their villagers: pretty, but they never grow. [i]Living Fields[/i] turns those fields into real crops. Villagers plant, water and harvest them, and the crops run through the seasons like any you'd grow yourself.[/size]

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/TVLxM2L.png[/img][/center]
[size=4][i]- [b]Real, villager-tended crops[/b]: each painted field becomes soil and crops that sprout, grow and ripen over the days. Villagers water them and harvest in the afternoon, each field at its own time.[/i][/size]
[spoiler][center][size=4][i][img]https://i.imgur.com/Ac2qeL2.gif[/img]
Villagers plant, water and harvest them through the seasons.[/i][/size][/center]
[/spoiler]
[size=4][i]- [b]Left to the villagers[/b]: you can't harvest, plant, fertilise, use tools on or shake bushes at their tiles, so their fields stay theirs.
- [b]Basic or Varied[/b]: Basic grows what the source mod paints. Varied gives each field a different in-season crop of the same kind, drawn from every crop your installed mods add (and Custom Bush bushes), and changes every season, every year. Switch any time: the fields pick up at the stage their schedule has that day.
- [b]Each farmer at their own pace[/b]: tidy farmers sow on time and keep their rows even; lazier ones sow late, skip a few nights and harvest less, so Andy's farm never looks quite like Evelyn's garden.
- [b]Plots with their own life[/b]: Emerald Farm's house and the Community Center garden grow by blocks, the Wizard's bed stays alive all year and replants every few harvests, Blue Moon Vineyard grows its grapes on trellises or as bushes, and Lani's sunflowers grow through spring to ripen in early summer.[/i][/size]
[spoiler][center][size=4][i][img]https://i.imgur.com/rP0l4nV.gif[/img]
Blue Moon Vineyard's grapes, on trellises or as bushes.[/i][/size][/center]
[/spoiler]
[size=4][i]- [b]Made to fit each map[/b]: on painted beds and planters only the plants show, so the map's own soil and walls stay. Painted giant crops stay as they are in Basic; in Varied they become real giant crops of the same size, a new one each season.
- [b]Every field on or off[/b]: switch any plot off in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][color=#e69138]GMCM[/color][/url] or [color=#f4f4f4]config.json[/color]; it gets its painted crops back and the crops this mod planted are cleared.[/i][/size][/left]
[left][size=4][b]Fields featured[/b]:
[i]- [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753][color=#e69138]Stardew Valley Expanded[/color][/url][/b]: Community Garden, Pierre's and Evelyn's back gardens, Emerald Farm and its house, Fairhaven Farm, Marnie's ranch, Leah's garden, Grampleton's field and raised bed, the Wizard's bed, Blue Moon Vineyard, and the Community Center garden.
- [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286][color=#e69138]Ridgeside Village[/color][/url][/b]: Blooming Hill Farm, Freddie's garden and Alissa's farm.
- [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11111][color=#e69138]Sunberry Village[/color][/url][/b]: the village and forest gardens, the empty cottage's bed, Maia's flower garden, Ripley's farm with her crop and flower beds (with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32660][color=#e69138]Ripley[/color][/url]; without her, the blue house's field and fenced bed), and Lani's sunflowers (with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32689][color=#e69138]Lani[/color][/url]).
- [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32872][color=#e69138]Downhill Project[/color][/url][/b]: Julia's garden.
- [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6754][color=#e69138]Aspen[/color][/url][/b]: Aspen's flower bed.
- [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6626][color=#e69138]Lunna: Astray in Stardew Valley[/color][/url][/b]: the Umuwi farms, growing LASV's own crops (off by default: switch it on in the settings).[/i][/size][/left]
[left][quote][size=4][b]SVE's [/b]Community Center plot belongs to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/54522][color=#e69138]Interactive Community Centre[/color][/url]'s crop plot while that is running (you plant the front half, villagers the back). Without it, or with its crop plot off, Living Fields farms the garden, once the Community Center is restored.[/size][/quote][/left]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Uohxu8h.png[/img]
[center][size=4][b][color=#e69138]1.[/color][/b] Download and install [url=https://smapi.io/][color=#e69138]SMAPI[/color][/url].
[b][color=#e69138]2.[/color][/b] Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/54492][color=#e69138]SK's Core Engine[/color][/url] (required).
[b][color=#e69138]3.[/color][/b] (Optional) Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][color=#e69138]GMCM[/color][/url] for the in-game settings menu.
[b][color=#e69138]4.[/color][/b] Download this mod and drop it in your [color=#f4f4f4]Mods[/color] folder, next to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753][color=#e69138]Stardew Valley Expanded[/color][/url] and/or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286][color=#e69138]Ridgeside Village[/color][/url] or any of the other mods above.
[b][color=#e69138]5.[/color][/b] Play! Works on new and existing saves: the fields are planted when you load.[/size][/center]

[quote][i]Plots, crop pools and the art to erase are all data in [color=#f4f4f4]assets/data/plots.json[/color].[/i][/quote][img]https://i.imgur.com/imkFUui.png[/img]
[center][size=4][b][color=#e69138]1.[/color][/b] Load your save as the host.
[b][color=#e69138]2.[/color][/b] Type [b]lf_remove[/b] in the [url=https://smapi.io/][color=#e69138]SMAPI[/color][/url] console. It removes every soil tile and crop this mod planted, and the fields go back to their painted art. The mod stays off until you restart the game.
[b][color=#e69138]3.[/color][/b] Sleep to save, quit, and remove the mod from your [color=#f4f4f4]Mods[/color] folder.[/size][/center]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/qXg7DRQ.png[/img]
[left][b]Does it need SVE or RSV?[/b]
No. It farms the fields of whichever mods above you have. With none of them it does nothing.

[b]Does it work on my current save?[/b]
Yes. The fields are planted when you load it, each crop at the stage its schedule has that day.

[b]Does it work in multiplayer?[/b]
Yes. The host's game tends the fields. Every player should install it, so the painted art is replaced for them too.

[b]Why don't some fields show tilled soil?[/b]
Where the map paints its own beds, only the plants are drawn. The soil is still there: villagers water and fertilise it as usual, you just don't see it darken.

[b]Why can't I harvest the villagers' crops?[/b]
No, they're the villagers'.

[b]Is it safe to uninstall?[/b]
Yes, after one command: see [b]Uninstall[/b] above.[/left]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/efem2sa.png[/img]
[center][i]- No known limitations found yet.[/i][/center]
